core_obligations: Preserve univariate formal-power-series and numerator/denominator degree conditions.
Retain valuation cancellation, full division support, partial fractions, derivative construction and final bound.
Do not split parameter variants or support lemmas.
difficulty_reason: The authors cancel the denominator valuation using division elimination, separate its polynomial part, and use partial fractions. Geometric sums have logarithmic-size circuits; simultaneous differentiation produces all repeated-pole terms with short correction tails, yielding the truncation bound.

dedup.scope: Root source identity refresh zero. Formal Theorem26 is the independently advertised rational-series truncation construction; the earlier division result and all support are retained as context, not counted again.
